text: Salma's pregnant!! Due around May 14. She told me after book club, hasn't told her work yet. Her husband Pedro is apparently already painting the nursery. She's had a rough first trimester, really tired and off coffee completely, which for Salma is huge. Her mum's flying in from Lahore for the birth and staying the month after. I said I'd keep it quiet till her 12 week scan.
liam broke his wrist at 5 a side sat, cast for 6 wks. text him tues to see how the fracture clinic went
Gemma's mum has been in hospital since Thursday with pneumonia. Gemma's going up to Leeds to stay with her and will be back the day after she's discharged. Check in with her at the weekend.
Christening for baby Ruby is June 3rd at St Mary's, lunch at the pub afterwards. Joe and Aoife asked me to be godparent!! Need to find out what a godparent actually has to do.
Abdi says his little boy Theo has had chickenpox all week, off nursery till Monday at least. Abdi's knackered.

So I was just talking to Krisztina and um her dad had a fall last night, he's okay but they think he's cracked a rib, he's having an X-ray tomorrow morning and she's going with him. Remind me to message her tomorrow afternoon to ask how it went.
Simone - 20 wks scan 5/22, finding out the sex. she wants it to be a surprise for her husband Antoine so she'll get them to write it in a card
Helen's back is bad again. Physio twice a week. She hates the exercises.

Tamar had the baby!!! Little girl, Leah, born Oct 17 at 3am, 7lb 2. Both doing well. Labour was 20 hours and Tamar said she's never doing it again, but she was laughing. Eli's taken two weeks off and his parents are coming down on Saturday. Send flowers and a card to her house this week.
Fiona's son Eli has glandular fever, she's been off work looking after him. She's worried he'll miss his mocks in January.
pick up prescription, renew car tax, return Amazon parcel before Friday
Dawit's wife Aditi is expecting twins!! Due date is August 9 but they've been told twins usually come early. He looked terrified and thrilled at the same time.

Sunil's knee op got cancelled again, third time now. He's fuming. It's been pushed back to some time in the new year and in the meantime he can't run, can't play with the kids properly, and his boss is getting funny about all the time off. His wife Gemma says he's been sleeping badly too. I should take him out for a pint next week and let him rant.
Note to self: Jonah allergic to penicillin, found out the hard way. Also he's veggie now.
Aoife said Ruby's christening cake is from the bakery on Market St, they do the lemon one. Good to know for my own stuff.
Ann Thomas from next door had her hip replacement on Monday. Her daughter Rebecca is staying with her for a fortnight. Pop round with soup the week after she's home.
Bao starts mat leave March 28, baby's due April 19. She's nervous about the birth, first one, and her mum lives in Vietnam so won't be there till a week after.
Victor's been really low since his dad's diagnosis. Parkinson's. Doesn't want to talk about it much, just wants normal chat and football. Message him Sunday after the match.
Santiago and Julia's gender reveal party Saturday 4pm at theirs. Bring something pink AND something blue lol, they won't say.
Gym 7am. Dentist 2:30. Haircut moved to next week.

Arturo mentioned his daughter Jaya got her tonsils out yesterday. Ice lollies and Peppa Pig all day apparently. Off school the rest of the week. Arturo's working from home to look after her because his wife Julia is away at a conference in Berlin until Thursday. He said Jaya's been brilliant about it, braver than him at the dentist. Back to school on Monday if she's eating properly by then.
Called Mum. Uncle Sam is out of hospital, they put a stent in. He's on a strict diet now, no salt, which he's moaning about constantly.
Leah Nowak (Lee-Lee to everyone) is due on November 2nd. Baby shower the Saturday before, I'm doing the cake. Must order the topper by next week.
Krisztina's X-ray update: dad's rib is broken but no lung damage. He's home and grumpy. She sounded so relieved.
Pedro mentioned Salma's been really sick, morning sickness all day not just mornings. She's barely eating. Ginger biscuits?
Remind me to ring Gemma the day before her mum's discharge, she said she'd want help moving the bed downstairs.

Joe's sister Simone had her baby on 10/14, a boy called Santiago after their grandad. Joe's an uncle for the first time and won't shut up about it. Simone had a bit of a rough time, emergency C-section in the end, so she's in for a few more days. Antoine's mum is looking after the dog. Joe's driving down to see them on Friday and taking a hamper from all of us.
Helen's dog Biscuit had surgery on his leg yesterday, keyhole, should be fine. She's been a wreck about it all week.
Liam says the cast comes off November 21 then physio. He's gutted about missing the cup final. Also finally admitted he's been learning sourdough during all this.
Antoine and Simone are moving to a bigger place before the baby arrives, viewing a house in Didsbury Tuesday. Ask them how it went after.
Tamar's partner Eli said the night feeds are brutal. They're both shattered. I should drop off a lasagne at the weekend and not stay long.
Rebecca mentioned her son Theo is going in for grommets on December 4th. He's only three and she's dreading it more than him.
lunch w Abdi, he's into bouldering now, goes 3x a week, wants new shoes for his bday
Sunil's mum passed away last week. Funeral is Friday 11am at the crematorium, wake afterwards at his brother's. I'll go to the service. Send a card today.
Dawit and Aditi went for the 12 week scan this morning, all fine, two heartbeats. They're telling family at Sunday lunch.

Ok so quick recap from the school gates. Fiona's lad Eli is better, back in on Monday. Jaya's mum (Aditi?) said Jaya's broken her arm on the trampoline, she's got a sling and is milking it. And Mrs Reyes is off on maternity from half term, baby due December 12th, there's a collection going round for her. Chip in a tenner and sign the card by Thursday.
Gemma texted, mum's home. Discharged on the 15th, Gemma's staying a few days longer than planned. Sounds exhausted.
Don't forget Bao's baby shower is the weekend after her mat leave starts. She hinted she'd love one of those Sleepyhead pods, the grey one.

Victor's mum is having a heart bypass on June 3. He's flying back to Lisbon the day before and staying a fortnight after. He seemed calm but kept checking his phone. His sister Helen is already out there and has been doing all the hospital stuff, he feels guilty about that. He asked if I could water his plants and feed the cat Mochi while he's gone, I said yes obviously.
Aoife and Joe's anniversary is the same week as the christening, they're doing a weekend in Galway afterwards. Ruby's going to Aoife's mum.
Ann's hip is healing well, she's walking with one stick now. Rebecca's gone home. Ann loves crosswords and Agatha Christie, maybe a big puzzle book for her birthday in March.
jonah's gf Tamar Singh - nurse at the Royal, nights mostly. lives in Chorlton. into wild swimming
Need to book the car in for MOT and sort the gutter before winter.

Santiago called, Julia's in hospital, waters broke at 33 weeks. They're keeping her in to try to hold off labour. He's terrified. Ring him tonight and then again tomorrow morning. Their eldest Bao is staying with Julia's sister Ann so he can be at the hospital. They've had the steroid injections for the baby's lungs and the next 48 hours are the big thing apparently.
Pedro & Salma's anniversary 7/1. she wants a weekend away before the baby comes, he's thinking Lake District. He asked me to keep it quiet.
Krisztina's daughter Aditi has her driving test on May 30, third attempt, really nervous. Krisz said she's taking her out for a practice drive that morning. Text Aditi good luck the night before.

Just been on the phone to Arturo for ages. His wife Julia had a miscarriage last month and they're only telling close friends now. Julia's okay physically, back at work, but struggling. Arturo's trying to hold it together for both of them and the kids. He said what's helped most is people just treating them normally and inviting them to stuff. I said we'd have them round for dinner. Should actually set a date this week, not just say it.
Eli and Tamar's baby Leah has jaundice, back in hospital for light therapy. Should be home in a couple of days.
Bought the christening present for Ruby - silver bracelet, getting it engraved Saturday.
Abdi's dad is coming over from Hargeisa for 3 months from January 6th. First time he'll meet Theo. Abdi's a bit stressed about sorting the spare room.
Theo (Abdi's) chickenpox gone. Back at nursery.
Helen said her sister Fiona is doing IVF, second round, egg collection next week. Helen's going with her to the clinic. Don't mention it to Fiona unless she brings it up.
Rang about the grommets. Theo went in at 8, out by 10, eating toast by 11. Rebecca very relieved. She owes me a coffee for the pep talk apparently.
Simone and Antoine's baby shower got called off, Simone's on bed rest now with high blood pressure. They're doing a small thing at home instead after the baby's born. Check on her next week.
Sam and his wife Jaya - both into cycling, doing London to Brighton in June. Jaya's training for her first triathlon too.
Dr Petrov said the results should be back in 10 days. Follow-up appointment Nov 4 at 9:15.
Gemma's birthday Nov 30 - she said she's been eyeing up a proper coffee grinder. Mum's illness has wiped her out, she deserves a treat.
Liam's girlfriend Aoife Jensen is a midwife, she's the one who delivered Tamar's baby! Small world.
Victor flew back Sunday. Bypass went well, his mum is in ICU but stable. He's staying another week after she's moved to the ward. I need to send him a message to see how she's doing on Thursday.

Christening went lovely. Ruby screamed through the whole blessing then slept through lunch. Joe gave a speech and cried. Aoife's dad wasn't well enough to come though, he's got shingles, so they're doing a little visit to him next Saturday with the photos.
